subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 13 updates

question: Do the updated full-SHA action revisions have acceptable upstream provenance and compatibility for OpenClaw’s secret-bearing, publishing, security-scanning, and Codex-agent workflows once the exact-head checks finish?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow, but approving new executable third-party revisions inside privileged workflows requires repository-owner trust and supply-chain judgment that ordinary code review and CI cannot fully provide.

options.title: Approve after provenance review
options.body: Confirm the sensitive replacement SHAs and Codex contract, wait for the exact-head suite to pass, then merge the grouped update.

options.title: Split sensitive action updates
options.body: Separate token, Codex, Docker-publish, or CodeQL revisions whose upstream changes need deeper review, while allowing independently verified pins to proceed.

recommendation.title: Approve after provenance review
recommendation.body: Confirm the sensitive replacement SHAs and Codex contract, wait for the exact-head suite to pass, then merge the grouped update.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history connects this person most directly to release execution and Docker workflow hardening across the affected privileged paths.
